title: Send metrics to the staging collector
carries: Staging collector: http://collector.staging.internal:9411/v4/ingest, enabled by ENABLE_COLLECTOR_V2=1, auth header X-Collector-Key from COLLECTOR_KEY, body {"schema_version": 4, "points": [...]}.
why_not_in_repo: The endpoint, port, flag name, header and schema version were told to the agent in session 1 for later use and appear nowhere in the repository or in session 1's code (session 1 only writes a generic chunking helper).

learn: Fact: the staging collector listens on collector.staging.internal port 9411, ingest path /v4/ingest over plain http.

Fact: the collector is switched on by environment variable ENABLE_COLLECTOR_V2=1. Requests carry header X-Collector-Key with the value of environment variable COLLECTOR_KEY, and the JSON body is {"schema_version": 4, "points": [...]}.
stub.recall_query: staging collector host port path flag header schema_version
